philosophy.title: My Vision
philosophy.text: Photography is not merely capturing images, but a pursuit of raw emotions and suspended moments. Every gaze, shadow, and ray of light tells a singular story. My approach favors sincerity, purity of lines, and timeless elegance to elevate what is often unnoticed at first glance.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: The eye behind the lens
about.intro: Passionate photographer based in Cotonou, I turn every moment into a timeless memory. From fashion to weddings, corporate and portrait, my work explores light, emotion and authenticity.
about.journey_text: For over 8 years, I've worked with brands, creators and demanding individuals. Every project is a new story to tell, an aesthetic to build, an emotion to capture.
